thread:
Maria P.: Quick sync — need to lock scope & launch criteria for Console observability work this quarter: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics. Priorities: customer asks (2 enterprise), platform SLOs, and observability cost pilots. Tagging @Sam R., @Li Chen for data & feasibility.

Ajay K.: +1. Can we aim for phased launch? Phase 1: dashboards + cost breakdown; Phase 2: tracing hooks + error analytics.

Sam R. (SRE): Need signal on query cost before dashboards; heavy dashboards can spike infra. Can we cap query window and sampling? Also we need ingestion rate estimates from Li.

Li Chen: I can run a backfill estimate. Need a list of required metrics. Maria, can you share minimal metric set?

Maria P.: Minimal metrics: per-route latency p50/p95, token-cost-per-request, error-rate by model, request rate, tail-latency histograms. Also need per-customer cost allocation for Dedicated.

Nora G.: For tracing hooks: instrument request id propagation + gRPC span at model runtime + KV cache span. Low-effort: add span for model selection and fallback path.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline created: obs-tracing-hook-branch deployed to staging at commit abc123 :white_check_mark:.

Ajay K.: Launch criteria proposal (short): 1) Dashboards show p50/p95, cost-by-route, active clients; 2) Tracing hooks capture 95% of requests in staging; 3) Cost breakdown matches billing within 5%; 4) Error analytics surfaces top 5 regressions. Thoughts?

Sam R. (SRE): 3) won't be possible without billing signal mapping; need Li's mapping. 2) tracing 95% — depends on sampled paths. Suggest 90% but must cover tail.

Li Chen: I'll output ingestion cost estimate and billing mapping by EOD Fri. Quick sample config I used:
```
metrics = ["latency_p50","latency_p95","token_cost","errors","req_rate"]
sample_rate = 0.25
window = "24h"
```

Maria P.: Fine with 90% tracing capture. For cost accuracy, accept 10% variance for initial launch. We can iterate.

Nora G.: Implementation trade: if we keep sample_rate 0.25 we'll reduce infra load but lose low-frequency errors. Maybe adaptive sampling: sample all errors + 10% of successes.

Ajay K.: Adaptive sampling sounds good. Add rollout plan: canary 10% customers -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with rollback on cost spike >20% or error regressions >2x.

Sam R. (SRE): Add SLO rollback triggers: p95 increase >15% sustained for 10m OR error-rate doubling. Also need ops runbook for alerts and incident playbook.

Maria P.: Action items: Li - billing mapping + cost estimate by Fri; Nora - implement tracing hook PR + sampling by Wed; Ajay - draft rollout plan and launch checklist; Sam - write SLO rollback triggers and runbook. I'll consolidate into launch spec doc.

Li Chen: noted.

Nora G.: will open PR today, link once ready.

Ajay K.: I'll create a draft in product board and ping legal for Dedicated customer data policies.

Maria P.: Thanks team. Let's sync Wed 10am to review PRs. :calendar:
